parsed.explanation: State is perpetrator: explicit offence for gender presentation, enforced against visitors with imprisonment, fines and deportation, plus airport screening comparing appearance to passport, including 2025 X-ray anatomy checks, confiscation and refusal. Cases span 2013-2025, so pattern is current, though overall frequency is unquantified. Custody accounts include effeminate-detention cells, head-shaving, discarded hormones, beatings and forced rectal examinations amounting to torture, with prolonged detention and no effective remedy; organisations cannot register. Same-sex conduct law and absent resident recognition are secondary/climate only. No death penalty for presentation is documented, keeping score above 0.05, but universal outing at entry and severe custodial consequences place it in severe-risk tier near 0.15.
